name: humid_fan_restrict_1693_blower_humid_after_cooling_restricted
description: Blower install, restrict 'heat only': after cooling, a humid house (indoor dew point 58F) keeps the blower off for the 2 hours after cooling
notes: Dew points (feels_like.dew_point_f): indoor 77.0F at 52.0% / 76.0F at 53.7% = ~58F. Outdoor 70.0F at 49.1% = 50.01F dew point (dry: the #1691 humid-air guard does not block).

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: deleting the 'cooled within the last 2h' clause makes 20:00 read fan_activated (economizer) and 20:30 natural_ventilation (as the dry twin does). (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'hvac_fan_restrict_mode' (Issue #835 + #1693 humid clause) states the rule; production applies it in AutomationEngine._hvac_fan_restriction_verdict through humidity_facts.hvac_fan_restrict_humid. (c) occupant: the blower would blow the wet coil's water back into an already humid house.
